page.overview:
What is Cathuria?

Cathuria, the Land of Hope, is a fictional country created by the late American author H. P. Lovecraft for his 1919 short story "The White Ship".

A fabled land of otherworldly beauty that is thought to exist by many of those who live in the Dreamlands, Cathuria is regarded as a legend and is said to lie beyond the Basalt Pillars of the West. Basil Elton sailed beyond the pillars aboard the White Ship in his search for Cathuria but never found it. (: "The White Ship")
